sentences.en: After a succession of warm days, the weather became cold.
sentences.zh: 连续几个晴暖的日子之后，天气变得寒冷了。

sentences.en: Man approaches the unattainable truth through a succession of errors.
sentences.zh: 人们通过一连串的错误逐步接近无法达到的真理。

sentences.en: They won the Japan Cup three years in succession.
sentences.zh: 他们连续三年赢得了日本杯赛冠军。

senses.zh: 连续 - 连续不断的人[事物] - 继承，继任；继承权 形容词: successional
